en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm pond or small lake with reflections of buildings on the water. On the right shore stands a large, light‑colored guesthouse with multiple windows, adjoining lower annexes, and nearby smaller farm or utility buildings. A rowboat with several people is on the water in front of the guesthouse. Forested hills rise in the background and tall flagpoles stand at both sides of the scene. The caption at the bottom left reads "Hetzdorf. Pension u. Bad Sumpfmühle".
